reference.project: UniXNU-zorn (SM8650 / K80, same Adreno 750 gen70900 GPU family)
reference.why_same_blobs: The reference project pins these four gen70900 images for the SM8650 GPU this board also carries (qcom,kgsl-3d0 chipid 0x43051401, GPU 0x3d00000, GMU 0x3d68000). The sizes and digests below are its recorded values; TB710FU's own copies come from the stock vendor/odm partitions named in stock_paths.
